scope: Phase 0 source inventory; full resort survey and world placement remain open.

elena.limits: All 39 Elena-tagged public photos, the Esri aerial, 8 private map/3D references and 12 private neighbouring pool/approach photos were inspected: 60 distinct source records, with 17 byte-identical private Drive mirrors not double-counted. Hidden ground geometry, tunnel identity, opposite terminal views and cross-area registration remain explicit gaps. Scoped source accounting does not mean a completed physical map.

tunnels.identity: observed source group; current host assignment remains candidate
tunnels.access: private/gated beyond forecourt; covered threshold visibly open; public through-access unproven
tunnels.nextAction: Register both portal photos to independent ground anchors; keep private gate distinct from covered portal.

tunnels.identity: legacy registry/aerial candidate only; not matched to far arch
tunnels.nextAction: Obtain signed opposite-end ground views of 6265201UF1366N_part2 candidate; resolve whether far roof-view arch is same physical connection before adding/merging identities.

evidenceRequests.needed: Independent ground-wall controls and both-end portal views, not roof corners or phone GPS; held-out registration for north/south lane and both tunnel candidates.
Views behind magnolia/hedges and down wall returns from shared path; no private interiors requested.
Ground views from both ends of legacy 6265201UF1366N_part2 and landmarks to distinguish the roof-view farther arch.

Obtain an independently anchored reverse view from the pool gateway back into Elena; private09/12 already provide closer same-direction iron-gate/material context but do not establish world pose or reverse connectivity.
Measured kerb/threshold relationships and calibrated ramp/stair dimensions; existing estimated metre values are not source measurements.

cervantes.limits: Scoped available-source inventory: 26 area-tagged public photos, four neighbouring public views, the Esri ground image and 20 private references. Source-relative observations only; physical map, registered edges, tunnel identity and measured clearance remain unresolved.

tunnels.identity: CALLE MIGUEL interior in IMG2288 is a separate signed source group. Its host and relationship to all legacy registry candidates, including tun-008, are unresolved.
tunnels.access: A visible corridor continues beyond an arch; public access and its two world connections remain unknown.

portals.status: far arch observed in source pixels; world position unknown

tunnels.nextAction: Obtain opposite view/shared physical anchors before assigning a host, world portals or through-route.

evidenceRequests.needed: Register both finite physical path edges and ground wall endpoints using identifiable ground controls/held-out points; keep roof/parapet outlines separate.

Find opposite/entrance view and shared architectural anchors for IMG2288 CALLE MIGUEL; resolve host, both portal positions and relationship (if any) to legacy tun-008. Exterior CALLE DE MIGUEL plaque alone is insufficient.
Obtain ground/reverse views of hidden patio-wall ends, house joins and gaps below roof eaves; do not complete enclosure perimeters from roof shape.
Resolve photo-read 0.4–0.5 m versus survey ~0.21 m at shared ramp; independently measure route clear width, tread/rise and garden-door projecting steps plus raised sill.
Ground views of far eastern corridor/parking contact and both edge transitions; existing route axis and distant cars do not trace the terminal width/boundary.
